calls.summary: The call focused on GrowthBook’s integration challenges with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, particularly SDK conflicts in the Rhino backend environment, flickering, and caching issues. Jake Heier (sales) and Jeremy (technical lead) from GrowthBook proposed a server-side CDN payload fetch with client-side SDK embedding to avoid flicker and core web vitals impact, while discussing managed vs external data sources for metrics.
